mapper.select: SELECT gp.id AS good_place_id, gp.group_id, gp.created_at AS good_place_created_at, p.id AS place_id, p.name AS place_name, p.category_name, p.road_address_name, p.x, p.y FROM good_places gp JOIN places p ON p.id = gp.place_id WHERE gp.user_id = #{userId} AND gp.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY gp.created_at DESC
